# CG-AUTH-005: OAuth2 flow changed

An OAuth2 flow was removed, its URLs changed or declared scopes removed (or only descriptive fields changed).

**Why it matters:** Token acquisition depends on flow definitions.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Security](./#auth) |
| Detects | `securityScheme.changed` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Security scheme "{scheme}" changed ({fields}).
>
> {explanation}
>
> **Fix:** {resolution}

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: flow removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
      oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
-     other: {type: oauth2, flows: {password: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r}}}}
+     other: {type: oauth2, flows: {}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Security scheme "other" changed (flows.password).

### Fires: tokenUrl changed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t1', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
+     oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t2', scopes: {read: r, write: w}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. Security scheme "oauth" changed (flows.clientCredentials.tokenUrl).

### Fires: bearerFormat only is informational

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer}
+     bearer: {type: http, scheme: bearer, bearerFormat: JWT}
```

**Result:** Informational, info. Security scheme "bearer" changed (bearerFormat).

### Does not fire: scope description edited

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get: {responses: {'200': {description: ok}}}
  components:
    securitySchemes:
-     oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: r}}}}
+     oauth: {type: oauth2, flows: {clientCredentials: {tokenUrl: 'https://t', scopes: {read: reading}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

```yaml

  ignore:
    - rule: CG-AUTH-005
      operation: "GET /example"   # optional: narrow it down
      reason: "Explain why this is acceptable"
      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
  overrides:

```
